title: Similarity-based OSF Logic for Flexible SPARQL Query Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.26261v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present an updated version of fosf, a reasoner for fuzzy order-sorted feature (OSF) logic, with support for flexible SPARQL query answering over RDF knowledge graphs. Fuzzy OSF logic is a knowledge representation and reasoning language where feature symbols denote functions and sort symbols denote fuzzy sets. Sorts are organized in a fuzzy subsumption relation that extends to OSF terms, record-like structures representing classes of entities. The unification algorithm for these structures provides a calculus of fuzzy type subsumption. The latest release of fosf introduces support for similarity-based reasoning by extending the OSF language with a similarity relation among sorts, alongside a translation engine for compiling OSF terms into standard SPARQL. translated_title: 基于相似度的OSF逻辑实现灵活的SPARQL查询回答
translated_abstract: 我们提出了fosf的更新版本，fosf是一个模糊序类特征（OSF）逻辑推理器，支持对RDF知识图谱进行灵活的SPARQL查询回答。模糊OSF逻辑是一种知识表示与推理语言，其中特征符号表示函数，类符号表示模糊集合。类之间通过模糊包含关系组织起来，且该关系可扩展到OSF项——即表示实体类的记录式结构。针对这些结构的统一算法提供了模糊类型包含的演算。最新版本的fosf通过在OSF语言中引入类之间的相似度关系，增加了对基于相似度推理的支持，同时还提供了一个将OSF项编译为标准SPARQL的翻译引擎。以OSF项形式表达的查询在翻译之前会先经过模糊的本体感知重写，该过程融入了包含类定义、特征定义域和值域声明的OSF理论……（摘要原文此处截断）
tldr: fosf推理器通过在OSF语言中引入类间相似度关系以支持基于相似度的推理，并将OSF查询经模糊本体感知重写后编译为标准SPARQL，实现了对RDF知识图谱的灵活SPARQL查询回答。
en_tdlr: The updated fosf reasoner extends fuzzy OSF logic with a similarity relation among sorts and compiles fuzzy ontology-aware rewritten OSF terms into standard SPARQL, enabling flexible SPARQL query answering over RDF knowledge graphs.
